SOM.note: No authentication, e-signature or PKI service is stated.

facts.fact: Hiiraan Online reports that the Civil Registration Management and Vital Statistics System (CRMVS), delivered in November with NADRA funding, is a cornerstone of Somalia's National Identification System project, and that NIRA is tasked with managing the system.

SOM.note: Only a target of 15 million registered by the 2026 elections is stated, no count enrolled.
No identity number at birth is stated.

facts.fact: Hiiraan Online reports that Somalia's 2018 partnership with Pakistan's NADRA included a $10.5 million grant and a comprehensive transfer of technology and expertise.

SOM.note: No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Hiiraan Online reports that the National Identity Management System was inaugurated in September 2023 and that biometric ID cards have been issued, the first in more than three decades, per the Prime Minister.
